learning_outcomes.text: Design a mechanical system which incorporates properly specified standard components.
Perform appropriate engineering analysis to support the design process.
Evaluate designs in terms of engineering standards, sustainability and safety.
Document design outputs to appropriate standards.

syllabus_topics: Collaborative design briefs, needs recognition and creation of effective design specifications
Design for Manufacture, Bills of Process and process planning
Evaluation of the sustainability of a design in terms of the materials and processes which are used and its operational lifecycle
Embodiment design, layout planning, part modelling
Design factors such as strength and service life (using specifications to communicate design intent and other constraints on the design and/or selection of components)
Standards relating to the design of engineering components (dimensioning practice, tolerances, surface finishes)
